findings.evidence: Mixed catalog fingerprints. Metadata hashes the ordinary subset, while authoritative ordinary/reconciliation/full-rebuild and streamed-rebuild validation still use the three-argument all-route overload. A mixed catalog is rejected before its enabled fold; use the advertised capability subset consistently and test all receiving paths.

Disabled receiving route. DispatchCoreAsync selects named handlers without OrdinaryDeliveryEnabled. The catalog-registry overload admits the complete inventory, so a disabled handler can execute despite ordinary discovery excluding it; gate ordinary dispatch while retaining rebuild admission.

Cross-identity reader privileges. VerifiedJwtReader binds lifetime/identity claims to one authenticated identity, but AdmitAsync passes the original principal to ClaimsTenantValidator and ClaimsRbacValidator, both of which aggregate claims. An unrelated identity can supply tenant/admin privileges; authorize only the selected JWT reader identity.

Repeated recoverable gap evidence. RecordDeliveryConflictAsync includes AcceptedDigest in deduplication, and JournalAsync hashes the advancing accepted owner sequence. Retrying one future source/position/digest while its prefix advances creates redundant durable gap entries and can exhaust the audit; deduplicate the same rejected gap identity without conflating distinct payloads.

Token body deadline. ResponseHeadersRead completes the HttpClient timeout at headers; subsequent reads have only caller cancellation while the singleton gate is held. A stalled body can indefinitely block later acquisition; apply the configured bounded deadline through the complete body and release the gate on timeout.

Rollback fixture sidecar identity. The fixed-port health probe runs before process-liveness checking and never verifies app-id. An occupied Dapr port may select a foreign sidecar for the projection lane; allocate isolated endpoints and verify metadata identity before either lane.

carried B9: Local candidate delivery gate. The unchanged clean CI restore cannot retrieve ignored private SDK/Platform identities. The approved remediation explicitly retains upstream publication and public-pin delivery as a separate unresolved gate; no public publication or merge/release readiness is authorized/claimed.

Package proof cache isolation. verify-story414-sdk-candidate.sh creates a temporary project but retains the shared global package cache. Cached private identities can mask a missing/different current candidate feed; isolate restored packages and compare intended candidate archive hashes.

Scaling latency remains unverified (medium if substantiated). The fold visibly reloads all histories and compares all proposed documents, so round trips grow with membership. The review provides no latency-bearing run, reachable persisted boundary fixture, or measured delivery failure; retain a benchmark task to establish operational latency at admitted context/document limits before changing fold architecture.

Pure-fold detail degradation. GetWorkItem creates metadata from epoch stale state only and ignores the persisted rollUp.Degraded/diagnostics. A refused source contribution can be presented Current; propagate the existing domain degradation without changing accepted model contents.

Pre-verified regression gap: paged history length/digest integrity lacks a valid-JSON, same-length corruption case. Removing the digest comparison leaves positive growth/inline tests passing; exercise ordinary delivery against the corrupted persisted page and assert no accepted family/applied checkpoint rewrite.

Pre-verified regression gap: authority tests only reuse an immediate 300-second token. An indefinitely cached token mutation survives them; exercise short-lived expiry/replacement and rejected renewal without reusing expired bearer.

Mixed catalog fingerprint omission independently identified in ordinary, reconciliation, full rebuild and streamed validation. The advertised four-argument hash differs from the receiving historical overload when one route is rebuild-only.

Decimal roll-up capacity. BuildEpoch reaches RemainingBuckets.Add with independently valid decimal.MaxValue and 1 same-unit contributions; OverflowException escapes both the Works InvalidOperation catch and SDK bounded fold handling. The reviewer reproduced pending=1/failures=0/parked=0/degraded=false. Map demonstrated numeric representation overflow to durable non-poison capacity with accepted state retained.

Pure-fold degradation in both queries. Created/Queued then wrong-unit ProgressReported persists rollUp.Degraded=true while list and detail return Current/IsDegraded=false in the executable review reproduction. Pin/check relevant roll-ups and report their existing degradation/diagnostics truthfully.
